Manage reference-only MCP definitions and per-profile switches

Usage: larp cc mcp [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add       Add a reference-only server definition (disabled unless sync-all is on)
  remove    Remove a definition, its switches and its renders
  enable    Enable a server for one profile or for all profiles
  disable   Disable a server for one profile or for all profiles
  list      List definitions by reference name only
  matrix    Show the per-profile switch matrix
  sync-all  Inherit definitions on all current and future profiles (on) or stop (off)
  sync      Render all profiles or explicitly resume an interrupted transaction

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
